name: mysquadgo-backend
description: MySquadGo WhatsApp bot + trip planning API

scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{const p=require('puppeteer'),fs=require('fs');const e=p.executablePath();if(e&&fs.existsSync(e)){fs.writeFileSync('.chrome-path',e);console.log('[postinstall] Chrome saved:',e);}else{console.log('[postinstall] Chrome not found at:',e);}}catch(err){console.log('[postinstall] err:',err.message);}"
